    diagonal_pairs = []

        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r, c) not in seen_cells:
                color = grid[r][c]

                    diag_pair = ((r, c), (r + 1, c + 1))
                    diagonal_pairs.append((diag_pair, color))
                    seen_cells.update(diag_pair)
                # Check for diagonal neighbor (r+1, c-1)
                elif r + 1 < rows and c > 0 and grid[r + 1][c - 1] == color:
                    diag_pair = ((r, c), (r + 1, c - 1))
                    diagonal_pairs.append((diag_pair, color))
                    seen_cells.update(diag_pair)
    
    # Process diagonal pairs - convert to horizontal at upper row
    for (c1, c2), color in diagonal_pairs:
        r = min(c1[0], c2[0])
        c_min = min(c1[1], c2[1])
        result[r][c_min] = color
        result[r][c_min + 1] = color
    
    # Copy all other cells to result
    visited = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r, c) not in visited:
                # Check if this cell was in a diagonal pair
                in_pair = False

                    result[r][c] = grid[r][c]
                    visited.add((r, c))

def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    result = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    
    # Process diagonal pairs and convert to horizontal
    visited = set()
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r, c) not in visited:
                color = grid[r][c]
                
                # Check all 8 neighbors to see if this forms a pair
                neighbors = [(r+1,c+1), (r+1,c-1), (r-1,c+1), (r-1,c-1),
                           (r+1,c), (r-1,c), (r,c+1), (r,c-1)]
                
                pair_found = False
                for nr, nc in neighbors:
                    if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                        if grid[nr][nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                            # This is a pair
                            row_pair = min(r, nr)
                            col_pair = min(c, nc)
                            # Place as horizontal at upper row
                            result[row_pair][col_pair] = color
                            result[row_pair][col_pair + 1] = color
                            visited.add((r, c))
                            visited.add((nr, nc))
                            pair_found = True
                            break
                
                if not pair_found:
                    # Single cell or non-diagonal, place as is
                    result[r][c] = grid[r][c]
                    visited.add((r, c))
    
    return result
